Batch 19 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 19 resolves 16 classic syndicated radio broadcasts: 8 dramatic true-case docudramas from Macquarie Network's acclaimed medical history series Medical File (1952 master broadcast logs, recounting historic surgical breakthroughs and clinical cases), alongside 8 weekly slapstick variety sketches from the 1954 syndication run of Komedy Kingdom.

1. Medical File — 1952 Macquarie Network Master Discs Dated

Dramatizing real historical medical cases and clinical discoveries from physician archives:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Clinical Case Subject
Medical_File_Sir_Henry_Holland.mp3 "Medical File: Sir Henry Holland (Pioneer Frontier Eye Surgeon)" 1952-10-07 The legendary British surgeon who performed thousands of cataract surgeries on the frontier.
Medical_File_Dr_Dover.mp3 "Medical File: The Amazing Dr. Dover (Privateer & Physician)" 1952-10-14 Dr. Thomas Dover's dual career rescuing Alexander Selkirk and inventing Dover's Powder.
Medical_File_Star_Crossed_Lovers.mp3 "Medical File: The Star-Crossed Lovers" 1952-10-21 Diagnostic puzzle unraveling severe psychosomatic cardiology symptoms.
Medical_File_Beauty_In_Distress.mp3 "Medical File: Beauty in Distress" 1952-10-28 Reconstructive trauma surgery saves an injured dancer's career.
Medical_File_Broken_Doll.mp3 "Medical File: The Broken Doll" 1952-11-04 Pediatric orthopedic rehabilitation case at the Children's Hospital.
Medical_File_Life_In_Dark.mp3 "Medical File: Life in the Dark" 1952-11-11 Breakthrough corneal transplant operation restores sight to a blinded factory worker.
Medical_File_Seven_Year_Itch.mp3 "Medical File: The Seven-Year Itch" 1952-11-18 Dermatological detective work identifies rare industrial allergen exposure.
Medical_File_Turn_For_Better.mp3 "Medical File: A Turn for the Better" 1952-11-25 Emergency hospital triage crisis resolves following innovative clinical therapy.
